column1: happy|/ˈhæpi/|adj.|快乐的；满意的|基础|emotion-basic|feel happy::感到高兴;happy with::对……满意|I feel happy when I spend time outdoors.::在户外活动时，我会感到高兴。|They were happy with the final result.::他们对最终结果感到满意。
sad|/sæd/|adj.|悲伤的；令人难过的|基础|emotion-basic|feel sad::感到难过;sad news::令人难过的消息|She felt sad when her friend moved away.::朋友搬走时，她感到难过。|The letter brought some sad news.::这封信带来了一些令人难过的消息。
afraid|/əˈfreɪd/|adj.|害怕的；担心的|基础|emotion-basic|afraid of::害怕;afraid to::不敢做|The child was afraid of the dark.::这个孩子害怕黑暗。|Do not be afraid to ask for help.::不要害怕寻求帮助。

angry|/ˈæŋɡri/|adj.|生气的；愤怒的|基础|emotion-basic|angry with::生……的气;angry about::对……生气|He was angry about the sudden change of plan.::他对计划突然改变感到生气。|She was angry with herself for losing the key.::她因弄丢钥匙而生自己的气。
calm|/kɑːm/|adj.; v.|平静的；使平静|基础|emotion-basic|stay calm::保持冷静;calm down::平静下来|Try to stay calm while we find a solution.::我们寻找解决办法时，尽量保持冷静。|The sound of the rain helped calm her.::雨声帮助她平静下来。

excitement|/ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/|n.|兴奋；激动；令人激动的事|四级|emotion-basic|with excitement::兴奋地;a sense of excitement::兴奋感|The children talked with excitement about the trip.::孩子们兴奋地谈论这次旅行。|There was a sense of excitement before the concert.::音乐会开始前，现场弥漫着兴奋的气氛。

worried|/ˈwɜːrid/|adj.|担心的；忧虑的|基础|emotion-basic|worried about::为……担心;look worried::看上去忧虑|She looked worried when she heard the news.::听到消息时，她看上去很忧虑。|I am worried about the weather for our journey.::我担心旅途中的天气。
anxious|/ˈæŋkʃəs/|adj.|焦虑的；急切的|基础|anxious|anxious about::为……焦虑;anxious to::急于做|He felt anxious about the upcoming interview.::他对即将到来的面试感到焦虑。|We are anxious to hear your opinion.::我们急切地想听到你的意见。

anxiety|/æŋˈzaɪəti/|n.|焦虑；忧虑|基础|anxious|a feeling of anxiety::焦虑感;anxiety about::对……的忧虑|Waiting for the results caused her some anxiety.::等待结果让她有些焦虑。|The discussion revealed anxiety about future changes.::讨论中流露出对未来变化的忧虑。

confident|/ˈkɑːnfɪdənt/|adj.|自信的；有把握的|基础|confident|confident about::对……有信心;confident that::确信|She feels more confident after regular practice.::经常练习后，她更有自信了。|We are confident that the plan will work.::我们确信这个计划会奏效。

confidence|/ˈkɑːnfɪdəns/|n.|信心；信任|四级|confident|gain confidence::增强信心;have confidence in::对……有信心|Speaking in small groups helped him gain confidence.::在小组中发言帮助他增强了信心。|The team has confidence in its new leader.::团队对新领导者有信心。
proud|/praʊd/|adj.|自豪的；骄傲的|基础|proud|proud of::为……自豪;feel proud::感到自豪|Her family is proud of what she achieved.::家人为她的成就感到自豪。|He was too proud to admit his mistake.::他太骄傲，不愿承认错误。
pride|/praɪd/|n.|自豪；骄傲；自尊|基础|proud|take pride in::以……为荣;a sense of pride::自豪感|The workers take pride in their careful work.::工人们为自己细致的工作感到自豪。|She read the letter with a sense of pride.::她怀着自豪感读了这封信。
ashamed|/əˈʃeɪmd/|adj.|羞愧的；难为情的|基础|shame|ashamed of::为……羞愧;ashamed to::不好意思做|He felt ashamed of his rude words.::他为自己粗鲁的话感到羞愧。|She was ashamed to ask the same question again.::她不好意思再问同一个问题。
shame|/ʃeɪm/|n.|羞耻；遗憾的事|基础|shame|a sense of shame::羞愧感;what a shame::真遗憾|He spoke openly about his sense of shame.::他坦率地谈起了自己的羞愧感。|It is a shame that you cannot join us.::你不能和我们一起去，真遗憾。
hope|/hoʊp/|n.; v.|希望；期望|基础|hope|hope for::期待;a source of hope::希望的来源|We hope to finish the work before Friday.::我们希望在周五前完成工作。|The small improvement gave the team new hope.::这一小进步给团队带来了新的希望。

hopeful|/ˈhoʊpfəl/|adj.|抱有希望的；有希望的|基础|hope|hopeful about::对……抱有希望;a hopeful sign::可喜的迹象|She remains hopeful about the future.::她仍然对未来抱有希望。|The first successful test was a hopeful sign.::第一次测试成功是个可喜的迹象。
fear|/fɪr/|n.; v.|害怕；担忧|基础|emotion-basic|fear of::对……的恐惧;for fear of::唯恐|Fear of failure stopped him from trying.::对失败的恐惧使他不敢尝试。|Many residents fear that the road will become busier.::许多居民担心道路会变得更繁忙。
courage|/ˈkɜːrɪdʒ/|n.|勇气；胆量|基础|emotion-basic|have the courage::有勇气;take courage::鼓起勇气|It took courage to admit the mistake.::承认这个错误需要勇气。|Her story gave others the courage to speak.::她的故事给了其他人发言的勇气。
brave|/breɪv/|adj.|勇敢的；无畏的|基础|emotion-basic|a brave decision::勇敢的决定;be brave::勇敢|It was a brave decision to start again.::重新开始是个勇敢的决定。|The child tried to be brave during the storm.::暴风雨中，孩子努力表现得勇敢。

honest|/ˈɑːnɪst/|adj.|诚实的；坦率的|基础|honest|be honest with::对……坦诚;an honest answer::诚实的回答|Please be honest with me about the problem.::请坦诚地告诉我这个问题。|She gave an honest answer to a difficult question.::她诚实地回答了一个棘手的问题。

honesty|/ˈɑːnɪsti/|n.|诚实；坦诚|四级|honest|value honesty::重视诚实;in all honesty::说实话|We value honesty even when the truth is difficult.::即使真相难以接受，我们也重视诚实。|In all honesty, I do not understand the plan.::说实话，我不明白这个计划。

polite|/pəˈlaɪt/|adj.|有礼貌的；客气的|基础|character-independent|be polite to::对……有礼貌;a polite reply::礼貌的回复|The staff were polite to every visitor.::工作人员对每位访客都很有礼貌。|She sent a polite reply declining the invitation.::她礼貌地回复，谢绝了邀请。

courtesy|/ˈkɜːrtəsi/|n.|礼貌；客气；礼遇|六级|character-independent|common courtesy::基本礼貌;as a courtesy::出于礼貌|A short reply is a matter of common courtesy.::简短回复是基本礼貌。|They provided a map as a courtesy to visitors.::他们出于礼遇向访客提供了地图。
modest|/ˈmɑːdɪst/|adj.|谦虚的；不大的；适度的|基础|modest|modest about::对……谦虚;a modest increase::小幅增长|She is modest about her achievements.::她对自己的成就很谦虚。|The project began with a modest budget.::项目最初的预算不大。
modesty|/ˈmɑːdɪsti/|n.|谦虚；谦逊|四级|modest|with modesty::谦虚地;false modesty::假谦虚|He accepted the praise with modesty.::他谦虚地接受了赞扬。|Her modesty made people comfortable around her.::她的谦逊让人们与她相处时感到自在。

curious|/ˈkjʊriəs/|adj.|好奇的；奇特的|基础|curious|curious about::对……好奇;a curious detail::奇特的细节|The children were curious about the old machine.::孩子们对那台旧机器很好奇。|There was a curious detail in the final paragraph.::最后一段里有一个奇特的细节。

curiosity|/ˌkjʊriˈɑːsəti/|n.|好奇心；稀奇事物|四级|curious|out of curiosity::出于好奇;satisfy one's curiosity::满足好奇心|I opened the box out of curiosity.::我出于好奇打开了盒子。|The exhibition encourages children's natural curiosity.::这个展览鼓励儿童天生的好奇心。

ambitious|/æmˈbɪʃəs/|adj.|有抱负的；雄心勃勃的|四级|ambition|an ambitious plan::宏大的计划;an ambitious student::有抱负的学生|The team has an ambitious plan for the next year.::团队对下一年有一个宏大的计划。|She is ambitious but willing to learn from others.::她有抱负，也愿意向他人学习。

ambition|/æmˈbɪʃən/|n.|抱负；志向；雄心|基础|ambition|achieve an ambition::实现抱负;career ambitions::职业抱负|His ambition is to become a teacher.::他的志向是成为教师。|The course helped her clarify her career ambitions.::这门课程帮助她明确了职业抱负。
